label: 新手入门主题清单
js: (() => { const d=document.querySelector('[data-testid=get-started-dialog]'); if(!d) return JSON.stringify({open:false}); const steps=[...d.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=get-started-step-]')].map(e=>({key:e.getAttribute('data-testid').replace('get-started-step-',''), title:e.textContent.replace(/^\d+/,'').trim()})); return JSON.stringify({ open:true, steps }) })()
